question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city_id
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) * 1.20
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as overall_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, q4_2019_sales, q4_2020_sales, overall_sales,
           NTILE(100) OVER (ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) as percentile_rank
    FROM product_sales
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, q4_2019_sales, q4_2020_sales
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE percentile_rank <= 20
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as total_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as total_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
)
SELECT tp.prod_id,
       ROUND(tp.q4_2019_sales / t.total_q4_2019 * 100, 4) as share_2019,
       ROUND(tp.q4_2020_sales / t.total_q4_2020 * 100, 4) as share_2020,
       ROUND((tp.q4_2020_sales / t.total_q4_2020 * 100 - tp.q4_2019_sales / t.total_q4_2019 * 100), 4) as share_change
FROM top_products tp
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY share_change DESC
